actions.action: Verify the Finding Stories LinkedIn account, approve the project-overview post, and publish it through the authorized account.
actions.buyer_intent: Azizi Florence project details and availability
actions.reason: The complete advisory post has the strongest ready path from professional discovery to an attributable enquiry.
actions.dependency: Authorized account owner, copy approval and asset-rights confirmation.
actions.success_metric: Attributed LinkedIn sessions, WhatsApp clicks, lead_form_start and lead_success.
actions.revenue_connection: Professional discovery → buyer guide → advisor enquiry.
actions.evidence_required: Owned account URL, approval, public post URL, screenshot and publication time.

prioritization.scale: 1 (low) to 5 (high); effort, dependency risk and spam risk are costs

actions.action: Select one known, consented and contextually relevant buyer; approve and manually send the matching WhatsApp buyer message.
actions.reason: A relevant one-to-one share provides a short path to an advisor conversation without cold outreach.
actions.dependency: Authorized advisor must identify a consented relevant recipient.
actions.success_metric: Attributed visit, buyer reply, WhatsApp continuation or qualified lead.
actions.revenue_connection: Trusted share → advisor conversation → meeting opportunity.
actions.evidence_required: Privacy-safe internal send record and attributed outcome when available.

prioritization.scale: 1 (low) to 5 (high); effort, dependency risk and spam risk are costs

actions.action: Verify one existing professional relationship and approve the matching referral message; do not contact an unverified candidate.
actions.reason: A legitimate relationship can qualify audience context before a project visit.
actions.dependency: Relationship owner must document the relationship basis and approve copy.
actions.success_metric: One verified relationship and, after approval, attributed referral session or qualified enquiry.
actions.revenue_connection: Professional introduction → qualified project visit → enquiry.
actions.evidence_required: Privacy-safe relationship basis, approval and later send/result evidence.

prioritization.scale: 1 (low) to 5 (high); effort, dependency risk and spam risk are costs

actions.action: Verify one named, relevant editorial or directory target and record its current public eligibility or contact route without submitting.
actions.reason: Existing authority records contain candidate categories rather than verified target evidence.
actions.dependency: Human review of a real public target and current relevance.
actions.success_metric: One target with identity, relevance, route, last_checked and evidence URL verified.
actions.revenue_connection: Trusted discovery → referral visit → buyer enquiry.
actions.evidence_required: Target name, public domain, relevant current page, route and check date.

prioritization.scale: 1 (low) to 5 (high); effort, dependency risk and spam risk are costs

actions.action: Export the Florence Search Console page report and review available organic/referral lead attribution; leave every unavailable metric null.
actions.reason: Real query and conversion evidence is required before any content refresh decision.
actions.dependency: Authorized Search Console and analytics/lead reporting access.
actions.success_metric: Dated exports covering page queries, clicks, impressions, CTR, position and attributable lead fields.
actions.revenue_connection: Evidence → better qualified acquisition decisions → attributable revenue follow-up.
actions.evidence_required: Export date/range, property, filters and privacy-safe lead report reference.

prioritization.scale: 1 (low) to 5 (high); effort, dependency risk and spam risk are costs
